scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm check:architecture && node --test test/unit/*.test.cjs
scripts.migrate: pnpm build && pnpm provision && node scripts/migrate.cjs
scripts.dev: pnpm infra:up && pnpm build && pnpm provision && node scripts/migrate.cjs && node scripts/seed.cjs && pnpm upgrade:state && node scripts/dev.cjs
scripts.test:integration: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/integration/*.test.cjs && pnpm --filter @ticketing/fulfillment verify && pnpm --filter @ticketing/analytics verify
